Package ro.sync.ecss.dom.wrappers.mutable

Class AuthorSource

java.lang.Object
javax.xml.transform.dom.DOMSource
ro.sync.ecss.dom.wrappers.mutable.AuthorSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
Source
@API(type=INTERNAL, src=PUBLIC) public class AuthorSource extends DOMSource
A DOM-like source over a author document model. DOMSource.getNode() will return a DOM implementation over the Author nodes model.
